commands.command: npx wrangler d1 create partyswoop-db 2>&1 | tee /tmp/d1-create-output.txt
commands.description: Create the D1 database on Cloudflare

commands.command: D1_ID=$(grep 'database_id' /tmp/d1-create-output.txt | sed 's/.*= *"\(.*\)"/\1/' | tr -d '"' | tr -d ' ') && sed -i '' "s/placeholder-replace-with-actual-id/$D1_ID/" wrangler.toml && echo "Updated wrangler.toml with database_id: $D1_ID"
commands.description: Extract database_id from creation output and update wrangler.toml

commands.command: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply partyswoop-db --remote
commands.description: Apply database migration to create tables in D1
Redeploy the Worker with the D1 binding
